svg.title: BEA design sheet
svg.text: 50s · nurse, off shift · eyes closed but not asleep · shape idea: the rounded bell
THE QUIET CAR · character design · v1
folded on the bag: the stillest
Reads bodies for a living. Authority without
volume; the face you instinctively trust.
Tired is designed in: heavier lower lids and
NO hospital badge or lanyard: she's off shift and
has put it away. A second ID would compete with
Noor's badge, the one wearable lie in the film.
The fob watch is her one bright accent (steel,
not colour). It catches the panel light.
Eyes-closed-but-awake is her signature: see the
expression sheet for awake vs. asleep.
